## MigrateResult.status property

Discriminant so consumers distinguish "ran and did nothing" from "ran and applied zero of N" from "ran and failed." Retrofitting this later would be breaking.

**Signature:**

```typescript
status: 'no-migrations-needed' | 'applied' | 'failed';
```
